recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. The current source already satisfies FHIR-3646, and further edits would duplicate existing normative text or reopen later FHIR-25923 terminology decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-3646 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 ConceptMap change request asking whether ConceptMap.element.map.equivalence values such as narrower were read from source to target or the reverse. The approved resolution said the relationship should be read from source to target, so narrower means the source concept is narrower than the target concept.
initial_application: The issue was applied historically in svn revision 3289, represented in git by 3de063f9c5f479625a4cd5d27f90691a2dfb68c4 with the subject '{#3646}: Sort out directionality of ConceptMap (and {#3694}: make concept name optional)'. That commit updated the then-current ConceptMap spreadsheet.
additional_context: ConceptMap has since been redesigned: the current active resource maps the old equivalence element to ConceptMap.group.element.target.relationship. Later Published issue FHIR-25923 replaced ambiguous broader/narrower codes with explicit source/target code names and is already represented on the combined branch. Later Applied issue FHIR-45006 confirms the same source-to-target reading for terminology-service closure-table text but is a separate page-specific issue.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The active ConceptMap StructureDefinition says ConceptMap.group.element.target.relationship is read from source to target, and the Concept Map Relationship code system defines source-is-narrower-than-target and source-is-broader-than-target explicitly.

related_jiras.note: Replaced ambiguous ConceptMap relationship code names with explicit source-is-narrower-than-target and source-is-broader-than-target codes; already represented on the combined branch.
Later terminology-service closure-table correction cites ConceptMap.group.element.target.relationship and confirms the same source-to-target reading, but it concerns a separate page.
